correctness.rationale: Theorem 1.4 of Liu-Xia rigorously proves the four infinite 25-progressions. Triangular-number values are odd by the established mod-4 dichotomy, and triangular residues modulo m are exhausted within 2m entries. A fixed list of 18 indices, all independently computed as 4 modulo 8, covers each of 124 nontriangular residue pairs for 1<=m<=24; the finite check examines all m and r, not a sample of n. Twenty-one explicit nonzero witnesses exclude every remaining class modulo 25. The standalone exact power-series computation agrees with the published theta coefficient identity at 501 indices and reproduces every witness.

originality.rationale: Both directly relevant original full texts were materially inspected. Andrews-El Bachraoui supply the modulo-four triangular classification; Liu-Xia explicitly print the four positive 25-progressions. Neither inspected work supplies the missing least-modulus result and its complete negative witness cover. Targeted bibliographic and semantic searches did not identify a statement covering the extra exclusion. This is a reasoned provisional originality judgment, not uniqueness certification.

value.rationale: Least modulus for a universal congruence is a natural, exact threshold for a partition/composition series. The result proves the first candidate modulus 25 from the known prime-5 congruences is genuinely minimal and that no further class occurs there. The finite obstruction certificate efficiently answers all smaller moduli in one natural complete classification rather than tabulating arbitrary examples. The infinite positive half is correctly credited to published work.
